title: I made a tool where you describe a building (or drop a photo) and Claude turns it into a Satisfactory blueprint
author: thiagoisdead2
selftext:
I’ve been building a free, open-source tool that turns a photo, a sketch or an idea into a real Satisfactory blueprint you can place from the Blueprints tab.

**How it works:** you chat with Claude (the desktop app’s Code tab or Claude Code) and say something like *“build this in Satisfactory”* plus a photo, or *“a glass dome greenhouse, 40 m wide, white frame”*. It asks a few questions (size, colours, which save), then designs the building from the game’s actual pieces: beams, foundations, glass walls, roofs and more.

**What you get:**

* **Blueprint Studio:** a 3D preview in your browser. You can orbit around the build, click pieces, and move, rotate, duplicate, delete or recolour them, with undo. One button puts it in your save.
* **Four sizes:** small (6×6, opens in the Mk3 designer), medium (10×10), large (20×20) and extra-large (40×40 foundations).
* **Cost estimate** from the game’s build recipes, plus which AWESOME Shop unlocks you need.
* **Production planner:** pick items and rates, switch alternate recipes, set clocks and miner tiers, and get machines, raw resources, power and belt tiers.
* **Ready-made production lines:** “build me a line for 5 Motors a minute” gives you a blueprint with machines set to their recipes, splitter/merger manifolds, belts and pipes at the right tier, input buffers, power poles and label signs.

I'll do more adjustments on the tool and soon I'll share :)
